en.hubeali:
Abu Ali Al Ashary, from Muhammad Bin Abdul Jabbar and Muhammad Bin Ismail, from Al Fazl Bin Shazaan, from Safwan Bin Yahya, from Abdul Rahman Bin Al Hajjaj,
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘In the Book of Ali<sup>asws</sup>: ‘In every month is an Umra’.
en.sarwar: 2. Abu Ali al-Ash’ariy has narrated from Muhammad ibn ‘Abd al-Jabbar and Muhammad ibn ‘Isma‘il has narrated from al-Fadl ibn Shadhan from Safwan ibn Yahya from ‘Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Hajjaj who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
It is in the book of Ali, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, that there is al-‘Umrah in every month.”’
